regime: captured-state diagnostic; no validation or sealed evaluation seed opened

observations.dux_progress: DUX fought twelve observed Cave encounters and rose from level 20 to 22 without a faint.

conclusion: The +2 direct-training margin is rejected. A four-level lead still allowed a full-health trainee to faint before damaging the opponent, contradicting the zero-faint contract.

additional_controls: Refuse direct fights when an opponent's same-type attack would be super effective.
Evolve the fragile Diglett precursor through switch participation rather than direct combat.
Prefer immediate Scratch or Slash over the two-turn Dig attack in ground-line training.
next_policy.reason: The next replay showed that level alone was insufficient: Jolteon was vulnerable to Ground and Dig's two-turn exchange left the ground-line trainee exposed. The final policy combines the measured level boundary with matchup and move-duration evidence.

still_unproven: Whether the combined five-level, type-aware, immediate-attack policy survives a full uninterrupted route.
Whether the full route reaches the level-55 team floor within its battle and healing budgets.
